units.source_text: 这时响起了乌鸦的叫声。

en.t: At that moment, the cawing of crows rang out.
Suddenly, the light changed from yellow to blue.

units.source_text: 变成特写的痛苦，悄悄地拖入周围的风景中。

en.t: The pain, now magnified in close-up, was quietly dragged into the surrounding landscape.

units.source_text: 四只乌鸦，与海岸平行，低低地滑翔。

en.t: Four crows glided low, parallel to the shore.

units.source_text: 伸展开的翅尖泛着暗绿色的光，不知为何，男人想起杀虫瓶里的氰酸钾。

en.t: The tips of their outstretched wings glimmered with a dark green light, and for some reason the man thought of the potassium cyanide in his insect-killing bottle.

units.source_text: 是呵，在没有忘记之前，该换个容器，再用塑料布裹好。

en.t: Yes, before he forgot, he ought to change the container and wrap it well in plastic.

units.source_text: 碰到湿气，那玩意儿可是立刻会溶化成糊状的呀……

en.t: If it came into contact with moisture, that stuff would immediately dissolve into a paste...
